claims.content: The Customer wants to list personal jewelry for auction.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer lists personal jewelry for auction.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: A Customer successfully lists one personal jewelry item for auction using the system.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer begins the action of listing a personal jewelry item for auction.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has completed the listing of the personal jewelry item for auction.
in_scope_actions: Customer lists personal jewelry for auction
excluded_adjacent_actions: Viewing or bidding on an already-listed auction item

claims.content: Customer
The Customer has a registered FREE membership account on JTVauctions.com.
The Customer meets the Website's age eligibility requirement: age 18 or over, or age 13 to 18 with permission of a parent or guardian.
The Customer is able to access the JTV platform's scheduling application.
The Customer clicks the 'Schedule' link in the top navigation bar of the JTVauctions.com website to begin listing an item for auction.
The Customer clicks the 'Schedule' link in the top navigation bar of the JTVauctions.com website.
The Customer accesses the JTV platform's scheduling application.

The Customer uses the scheduling application to select the personal jewelry item, manually input its auction data parameters (such as start/end date/time and reserve price), and schedule their own auction for listing; the scheduling application only permits scheduling of items that have an available image.
The auction for the personal jewelry item is scheduled.
Diverges from Step 3: The Customer chooses to list the jewelry item as fulfilled via drop-shipping, so the system does not take physical possession of the inventory.
Diverges from Step 3: The Customer chooses to have the auction listing appear on multiple separately branded sites (e.g., Zales, ICE.com) in addition to the primary JTVauctions.com site.

At step 3, if the jewelry item being listed does not have an available image, the product will not be eligible to appear on any product details page, search results, or catalog page. Exit: the product is not eligible for display.

At step 3, if the auction's starting and ending date/time are identical, the scheduling application prevents the auction from being created and displays an error message highlighting (color-coding) the offending data. Exit: the auction is not created.

missing_aspects: Recovery path after the missing-image display ineligibility is not documented (e.g., whether the Customer can upload an image and return to step 3).
Recovery path after the duplicate start/end time validation failure is not documented (e.g., whether the Customer can correct the times and resubmit).

claims.content: The auction event is created with all selected items and their applied and/or manually input data parameters; the listed personal jewelry item appears in the system with status 'Scheduled', including assigned start and end date/time, reserve price, and zero bids.

The scheduled auction for the personal jewelry item appears in the 'Scheduled Auctions' list within the JTVauctions.com scheduling application interface and is displayed in the Search Results table with its status indicated by blue text, distinguishing it from current live auctions.

The scheduled/listed item appears on a product details page (bidding page), search results, or catalog page only if it has an available image to display; if no image is available, it is ineligible to appear on any product details page, search results, or catalog page.

The item is counted in 'Auction Available Inventory (Jewelry)' only if it is both 'Auction Available' AND 'Auction Eligible' in the JTV enterprise systems, is in a valid 'sellable' physical inventory location and sellable realm ('white'), and has an available image in the JTV SuperNova system.

quality_flags.detail: [trigger_preconditions_coverage] The Trigger and Main Flow require the Customer to select a specific personal jewelry item in the scheduling application, but Preconditions do not establish that the Customer has such an item available to list (e.g., owns it or is authorized to sell it, and an item record exists in the system). Without that independent external state, the use case cannot start meaningfully; Main Flow step 3 silently assumes it. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (The cited evidence does not support that the item is specifically a 'personal jewelry item'.))

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] The main flow only ensures the selected item has an available image and then schedules the auction. It never verifies or establishes that the item is Auction Available, Auction Eligible, in a valid sellable physical inventory location/realm, or otherwise causes the item to be counted in Auction Available Inventory. Thus postcondition 4 is not a guaranteed consequence of the scheduling flow.

inconsistency_hints: The Main Flow jumps from accessing the scheduling application to a generic 'uses the scheduling application to schedule their own auction' step and then to 'auction is scheduled'. It does not include any step where the Customer enters or selects item data (e.g., jewelry details/image, reserve price, start/end date/time) that Postcondition 1 explicitly requires for the created auction event. Therefore the described flow does not reasonably reach the postcondition state.

Main Flow step 3 (claim index 2) compresses the listing process into 'schedule their own auction' and omits the Customer entering the jewelry item's data (description, images, start/end time). The Goal requires the Customer to list personal jewelry for auction, and the Exception Flow itself assumes item image and start/end time inputs at step 3. Therefore the complete behavior described in Main Flow does not align with the Goal.

Postcondition 3 makes the listed item's appearance on product/search/catalog pages conditional on having an available image, but Main Flow step 3 only covers selecting the item and entering auction data parameters; no step attaches or verifies an image before the auction is scheduled. As written, the flow does not establish the image-dependent state required by the postcondition.

citation_audit.description: Latest model-authored candidates after internal semantic grounding verification and DRA; aligned with delivered slots.
